pages.text: On death, $(l:offsprings/stalker)$(c)$(o)Stalkers$() can drop a Stalker Eye. This eye can be eaten as is, made into an Eye Sandwich to improve the nutrition provided, or used to create $(l:blocks/eyes)$(c)$(o)Eye blocks$(). Upon consumption, it enhances the night vision ability of the person for a limited time. With the Eye Sandwich, the potency of this effect is slightly reduced.

The bread gives it a crunchy exterior but the eye itself just melts on the tongue after it pops. The insides of the eye may stay together like pudding, but swirling it around a bit with the tongue can loosen up the liquid and then it will slide down the throat easily.
